revisionNote: This record identifies the repaired source by SHA-256 below; included in the same commit as those sources.
scope: Fix saved-wallet initialization order and contain rejected lazy views without changing mint/payment behavior. No merge or deployment.
fixes: Capture persisted wallet state before config creation can synchronously overwrite the cookie.
Wait for connecting/reconnecting to finish before consuming a queued Connect request.
Reuse the existing local error boundary around deferred views, preserving shell/providers; navigation clears the boundary and Reload clears a cached lazy rejection.

environment.browser: Installed Google Chrome via Playwright, headless
environment.publicWalletConfig: Same public WalletConnect project ID as earlier baseline/candidate runs

conditions.cache: disabled; fresh browser context per sample

acceptance.definition: Visible live-validated mint form with nine selectable tiers, enabled quantity input and Connect control. Full wallet readiness is separate.

results: Saved wallet renders immediately and early Connect waits for successful reconnection
One early Connect survives unsuccessful saved-wallet reconnection
Rejected Gallery download preserves wallet/navigation and Reload recovers

results.name: Public HTML has working navigation without JavaScript
Early mint input and one Connect request survive wallet initialization
An unfinished quantity edit keeps its text and focus through wallet handoff
One early admin Connect request opens the normal wallet modal
Actual wallet modal connects the real local wallet
Mint quotes preserve actual backing and fees for quantities one and two
Wallet persists through header navigation and browser history
Reload restores the connection cookie before the app mounts
Docs round trip keeps the wallet connected
Mobile menu navigates and releases its scroll lock
Another browser context receives no wallet state
RPC failure retains public navigation and retry recovers against the real RPC

economics.limits: Real-fork UI quote checks only; no asset lifecycle or blockchain broadcasts. Live fee revalidation before payment remains unchanged.
